name: agent-trust-card
description: ATC SDK v1.1.1 — issue, verify, and inspect Agent Trust Cards. Supports ATC/1.0 (single-sig Ed25519) and ATC v3.0 (multi-format multi-sig: Ed25519/JCS, EAT-CWT/CBOR, W3C VC JSON-LD). Includes CLI (`atc verify card.json`, `atc issue`, `atc inspect`), sync verifyATCSync(), async verifyATC() with optional revocation list fetch. Implements 10 controls (ATC-001 Identity through ATC-010 Runtime Trust, 8 required + 2 optional) using Ed25519 (RFC 8032) signatures and RFC 8785 JCS canonical JSON. Maintained by AliceLabs LLC (Wyoming, USA, 2026).
